programme.title: Bahs pret Covid
programme.desc: Normunds pandēmijas depresiju pārvar, spēlējot čellu Vecrīgā. Viņa brīvdabas skatuve ir gandrīz tukša. Čellists, baloži un policijas patruļas ir gandrīz vienīgās dzīvās dvēseles Doma laukumā. Normundam negribas iet mājās, jo meita un sieva ir viņu nokaitinājušas. Pēc 27 gadu kopdzīves viņš palicis viens ar savu meiteni – čellu ar slaido vidukli. "Covid-19" pandēmija bija pārbaudījums planētai Zeme un tās iemītniekiem. Miljoniem cilvēku visos kontinentos slimoja un mira. Protesti, potes, tuvinieku nāve un nodevība ierāva mūs pandēmijas pārvarēšanas karuselī, bet katrs no mums savu pandēmiju pārdzīvoja viens.

programme.title: V.I.P. - Veiksme. Intuīcija. Prāts
programme.desc: Pirmdienas vakars atvēlēts erudīcijai, prāta apcirkņu izvēdināšanai, labam azartam un jaunām zināšanām. Spēlēs komandas, kuru kapteines ir Beate Bergsone un Zane Vaļule. Beate Bergsone - komandas kapteine. Darbojas viesmīlības pasaulē. Studējusi žurnālistiku un personāla psiholoģiju, aizrāvusies ar runas mākslu, erudīcijas spēlēm un vīnu pasauli. Beatei patīk izaicināt savu prātu un uzticēties intuīcijai, viens no viņas sapņiem ir reiz ierunāt kādu multfilmas vai pasaku tēlu. Leina Markevica - vienkārši brīvmāksliniece, viegli pierunājama spontāniem plāniem un piedzīvojumiem, aizraujas ar improvizāciju un komēdiju. Patīk radīt apkārtējiem patīkamu noskaņojumu, prot neapjukt neparedzētās situācijās pat tad, kad nekas nenotiek pēc plāna, tāpēc draugi uztic svarīgu pasākumu organizēšanu tieši viņai. Olafs Arnicāns - strādā tehnoloģiju nozarē, kur jaunu informāciju apgūst ātri un ar vieglumu, brīvajā laikā lasa un skatās dokumentālās filmas. Patiesu dvēseles piepildījumu Olafs rod, dodoties dabā vai aktīvi sportojot. Viņš zina labākās sēņu vietas, taču šo vērtīgo informāciju rūpīgi glabā. Mīl arī eksperimentēt virtuvē. Zane Vaļule - komandas kapteine. No Augšdaugavas novada, kur strādā par Latgales zooloģiskā dārza ekskursiju vadītāju. 22 gadus pavadījusi skolas un universitātes solos, bet nu izbauda dienas bez mājasdarbiem. Piecus mēnešus dzīvojusi Kanādā, vairāk nekā gadu - automašīnā Jaunzēlandē. Ļoti patīk pārvietoties kājām un laimēt loterijās. Aivis Vaļulis - kapteines brālis. Strādā meliorācijas nozarē Jelgavas pusē. Domā tik ātri, ka pats reizēm netiek līdzi savam domu gājienam. Ievērības cienīgs fakts - sešas reizes pieveicis pārgājienu Kolka–Dubulti. Televīzijas raidījumus neskatās, bet pats tajos reizēm piedalās. Liene Lubāne – no Jēkabpils, studējusi vides zinātnes, šobrīd strādā privātā uzņēmumā, kas gatavo bērnu rotaļu laukumus. Liene ir kapteines draudzene, brīvajā laikā strādā savā lauku saimniecībā, iet pārgājienos un izlīdz draugiem, kas iesprūduši vētras izraisītos postījumos un netiek uz "V.I.P." ierakstu, tā pati kļūstot no līdzjutējas par dalībnieci.

programme.title: Sporta studija
programme.desc: "Mūsu uzņemtais virziens izsakāms neformālā sauklī "sports sabiedrībai!". Šis virziens tika uzsākts jau iepriekš ar "Tautas sporta" sižetu sērijām un sporta laukumu kampaņām. Turpmāk LTV Tautas sporta sižeti būs tradicionāla "Sporta studijas" sastāvdaļa. "Sporta Studiju" vadīs rūdītie sporta žurnālisti Dāvids Ernštreits un Reinis Ošenieks, kā arī jaunās sporta žurnālistikas zvaigznes Andris Auziņš, Matīss Timofejevs un Raimonds Gekišs. "Sporta studijas" aktualitātēm sekojiet https://www.facebook.com/LTVSportaStudija

programme.title: Aizliegtais paņēmiens
programme.desc: Lai uzzinātu par kāda notikuma patiesajiem apstākļiem vai iesaistīto personu nodomiem, raidījuma "Aizliegtais paņēmiens" komanda informācijas iegūšanai izmanto visdažādākos izmeklējošās žurnālistikas paņēmienus un žanrus – eksperimentus, testus, provokācijas, padziļinātus pētījumus, arī anonīmas intervijas. Žurnālisti padziļināti pēta un skatītājiem atklāj sociālpolitiskus tematus, kas ne vienmēr tiek izcelti citos medijos. Raidījums atklāj un atmasko, atsevišķos gadījumos sauc pie atbildības iesaistītās personas, norāda uz likumu nepilnībām, aicina mainīt pastāvošo kārtību, ja tā ir pretrunā sabiedrības interesēm. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta žurnālists Guntis Bojārs.

programme.title: Province
programme.desc: Ļūmaņu ģimene Vecumniekos ir ienācēji, lai gan pēc divdesmit šeit nodzīvotiem gadiem vietējie jau sen viņus uzskata par savējiem, riktīgi savējiem. Tur pie vainas varbūt ir arī tas, ka viņiem nav vienaldzīgi, kā dzīvo līdzcilvēki. Ar mērķi palīdzēt vietējai kopienai savulaik tapa "Ļūmaņu ģimenes fonds". Tā, pateicoties fonda darbībai, Vecumnieki tika pie daudzfunkcionāla sporta laukuma un vietējā mūzikas skola - pie jauna flīģeļa. Vēl viņi prot apvienot vietējos ļaudis gan talkās, gan sporta spēlēs, gan vācot ziedojumus. Kad sākās karš Ukrainā, Ļūmaņu ģimene uzskatīja, ka sēdēt malā un vienkārši visā tanī noraudzīties būtu noziedzīgi. Tāpēc šoruden uz Ukrainu devās kārtējais fonda organizētais konvojs.

programme.title: Rīta Panorāma
programme.desc: Enerģisks un iedvesmojošs sākums jaunai dienai! Ieskats gaidāmās dienas notikumos Latvijā un pasaulē, kultūras, izklaides un sporta ziņas, laika prognoze. Arī atskats uz aizvadītās dienas notikumiem, pievēršot uzmanību to attīstībai nakts laikā. Aizrautīgas sarunas ar viesiem un skanīgi muzikālie priekšnesumi. Raidījumu vada Gusts Kikusts, Sigurds Siliņš, Karīna Rubene, Danuta Juste, sporta ziņas lasa Reinis Ošenieks, Raimonds Gekišs, laika ziņas – Ilze Skudra, Ilze Golubeva, Toms Bricis.

programme.title: Pasaules panorāma
programme.desc: Globālo ziņu laikmetā notikums Āzijā vai Amerikas kontinentā jau rīt var mainīt dzīvi Eiropā, bet lēmums, kas pieņemts Rīgā – atbalsoties visā pasaulē. "Pasaules panorāma" piedāvā neatkarīgas un uzticamas ziņas, atspoguļojot un analizējot ārpolitikas aktualitātes, kā arī sarunas ar politologiem, ārpolitikas ekspertiem, pasaulē pazīstamām personībām par svarīgāko Baltijā un Ziemeļvalstīs, citviet Eiropā, kā arī visā pasaulē. Raidījumu vada LTV Ziņu dienesta ārzemju ziņu redaktori Toms Pastors un Ina Strazdiņa.

programme.title: Balkāni - aizmirstā Eiropas robeža
programme.desc: Žurnāliste Katja Adlere apmeklē tūristu iecienīto Horvātijas kūrortpilsētu Dubrovniku, Bosnijā tiekas ar motokluba "Night Wolves" pārstāvjiem, bet Albānijā plosto pa strauju upi gar kalniem, kuros slēpjas bagātīgas minerālu iegulas. Šo Eiropas nostūri Katja pirmoreiz apmeklēja Dienvidslāvijas neatkarības karu laikā. Trīsdesmit gadus vēlāk viņa atklāj skaistu reģionu, kas strauji mainās. Tomēr to mēdz uzskatīt par Eiropas vājo vietu, kur Krievija, Ķīna un islāma pasaule sacenšas ar Rietumiem par ietekmi un varu.

programme.title: Mērdoka noslēpumi
programme.desc: Toronto dokos tiek nogalināts Neitans Pīterss, gospeļu grupas "Jubilejas dziedoņi" dibinātājs un vadītājs. Atklājas, ka daļa grupas mūziķu slepus spēlē arī regtaimu, pret kuru asi iestājas atturības biedrības dāmas. Daktere Greisa sāk just simpātijas pret Lezliju Gārlendu.

programme.title: Alpu dakteris
programme.desc: Nav labākas vietas, kur patverties no pilsētas kņadas, trokšņa un stresa, kā kalni. Bet dzīvot tur? Dzimto Alpu mazpilsētiņu, saucot tās gaisotni par smacējošu un aprobežotu, Mārtins pameta jau pirms daudziem gadiem, lai kļūtu par veiksmīgu ārstu kosmopolītiskajā lielpilsētā Ņujorkā. Nu viņš ir atgriezies. Uz pavisam īsu apciemojumu, lai atkal drīz atvadītos. Taču no likteņa neizbēgsi - atgriešanās mājās izrādās uz palikšanu. Jo pārāk liels ir trieciens, uzzinot, ka viņa pirmā mīlestība, kas pēc Mārtina aizbraukšanas apprecēja viņa paša brāli Hansu, ir mirusi. Taču atstājusi meitu, par kuras esamību Mārtins nekad pat nebija zinājis! Ar to izrādās pietiekami, lai izlemtu palikt Pēkšņi kļuvis par tēvu, Mārtins vēlas uzzināt vairāk par savu jauniegūto meitu Lili, iemantot viņas uzticēšanos. Tā dēļ viņš ir gatavs pat mēģināt sadarboties ar savu jaunāko brāli Hansu, kas joprojām jūt aizvainojumu. Hanss ir kļuvis par glābēju komandas vadītāju, un kopā ar Mārtinu viņi turpmāk neskaitāmas reizes riskēs ar savu dzīvību, lai glābtu kalnu negadījumu upurus vai kāpējus, ko pārsteigusi pēkšņa vētra. Mārtinu gaida atklāsme, ka bez saknēm nav iespējas turpināt dzīvi. Šeit viņš pilnībā aptvers arī to, ka būt par ārstu kalnos - tā nav tikai profesija, bet gan aicinājums. Kļūt par labu neatliekamās medicīniskās palīdzības sniedzēju kalnos iemācīties nevar, par tādu piedzimst. Un Mārtins Grūbers tāds neapšaubāmi ir!

programme.title: Eiropas čempionāts volejbolā. Polija – Latvija
programme.desc: Latvija turpina cīņu Eiropas čempionāta finālturnīrā Stambulā, un ar katru spēli pieaug šādu turnīru pieredze. Nevienai mūsdienu Latvijas spēlētājai šāda līmeņa turnīros tādas nav, jo pirms 29 gadiem finālturnīrā spēlēja pavisam cita volejbolistu paaudze. Treneri un arī pašas spēlētājas ir pamatīgi pastrādājušas - vasaras sākumā bija astoņu nedēļu treniņu cikls, vēlāk neliela atelpa un tad - pēdējais sagatavošanās posms ar vairākām pārbaudes spēlēm. Polija ir ļoti spēcīga pretiniece, pēc reitinga otra spēcīgākā komanda pēc Turcijas mūsu apakšgrupā (polietes Eiropā ir piektās). Grūti būs, bet jācīnās un jāmēģina uzvarēt vismaz kādā setā, par ko (divi seti) mūsdienu volejbolā arī dod kādu punktu, un tas var noderēt beigās vietu sadalījumā grupā.

programme.title: Dzīvnieku stāsti
programme.desc: Dažus zālēdājus dzīve nelutina – uzreiz pēc dzimšanas viņi jau kļūst par medījumu. Taču ir arī tādi, kuriem klājas daudz labāk, piemēram, veiksmīgajai zebrai. Kā gan citādi nosaukt šo dzīvnieku, kurš piedzimis sausajā sezonā un visu mūžu, šķiet, atrodas laimīgas zvaigznes aizsardzībā? Saskaroties ar sausumu, plēsējiem un sāncenšiem, zebra vienmēr atrod veidu, kā izdzīvot. Gadu gaitā zebru tēviņš sāk valdīt pār savu rūpīgi un pacietīgi izveidoto nelielo harēmu. Vai tā patiešām ir tikai veiksme? Varbūt šī zebra vienkārši ir piesardzīgāka, veiklāka un gudrāka par pārējiem?

programme.title: UEFA Nāciju Līga. Futbola studija
programme.desc: Sarunas LTV studijā pirms un pēc Latvijas komandas spēlēm Nāciju līgā.

programme.title: Futbols. UEFA Nāciju līga
programme.desc: Spēle pretinieku laukumā Latvijai noteikti nebūs viegla. Paredzami gan labāki laika apstākļi, nekā tie parasti ir rudenī Latvijā, bet savās mājās kiprieši noteikti būs favorīti. Kipras futbolā ir ļoti liela Grieķijas ietekme, galvenais treneris ir grieķis, arī vairums izlases spēlētāju ikdienā spēlē dažādos Grieķijas klubos. Daži spēlētāji ir arī no Bulgārijas, Polijas, Serbijas un Rumānijas klubiem, protams, arī no Kipras čempionāta. Lielajās Eiropas līgās pašlaik neviens no kipriešiem nespēlē. Kopumā Kipras futbolisti ir tehniski, taču tie nejūtas komfortabli, ja neizdodas ilgstoši kontrolēt bumbu, tāpat dažkārt gadās kļūdas arī aizsardzībā. Latvijas izlases trenerim jāizdara secinājumi pēc iepriekšējās spēles ar kipriešiem mājās, varbūt jāveic kādas izmaiņas sastāvā un jācenšas izvēlēties pareizā spēles taktika. Latvijai nebūt nav sliktāks sastāvs, daudzi mūsu līderi tāpat spēlē ārvalstīs, tikai jāmāk izmantot spēlētāju potenciāls. Pašam trenerim Paolo Nikolato ilgtermiņa līguma vairs nav, vasarā netika iegūts Baltijas kauss, un neveiksme šajā Nāciju līgas ciklā varētu krietni sašūpot galvenā trenera krēslu un viņa iespēju noslēgt jaunu līgumu.

programme.title: 42 - Atbildes uz gandrīz visiem jautājumiem
programme.desc: Dokumentālo filmu cikls viegli saprotamā, taču zinātniski pamatotā veidā sniedz atbildes uz neparastiem jautājumiem. Un temati var būt visdažādākie, jautājumi – vispārsteidzošākie. Vai augiem ir emocijas, vai tie spēj just? Vai pasaules okeānu straumes drīz apstāsies? Kāpēc mēs patiesībā raudam? Zinātnieku sniegtās atbildes pārsteidz un liek paraudzīties uz pasauli no citas perspektīvas. Kāpēc nosaukumā ir skaitlis 42? Šeit dokumentālo filmu cikla veidotāji atsaucas uz rakstnieka Duglasa Adamsa zinātniskās fantastikas komēdijas grāmatu "Galaktikas ceļvedis stopētājiem", kurā superdators ir izskaitļojis, ka skaitlis 42 ir galīgā atbilde uz visiem Visuma jautājumiem.

programme.title: Midsomeras slepkavības
programme.desc: Detektīvs Toms Bārnabijs ir pacietīgs un metodisks izmeklētājs. Viņš saprot, ka noziegumiem mazā pilsētiņā vienmēr būs sociāls raksturs, tamdēļ svarīgi izprast tās iedzīvotāju attiecības. Tikai un vienīgi viņš spēj pamanīt neskaidrus mājienus un sadzīt pēdas viltīgam slepkavam brīdī, kad nupat, šķiet, tas izbēgs nesodīts. Kad Toms Bārnabijs atgriežas mājās, viņš ir mīlošs vīrs un tēvs, tomēr, neskatoties uz to, detektīvs viņā nekad nesnauž. Citreiz vistrāpīgākās atklāsmes rodas tieši pie brokastu galda! Seriāls "Midsomeras slepkavības" ieturēts vislabākajās britu klasiskā detektīva tradīcijās: virkne aizdomās turamo, sajauktas pēdas, mīklaini mājieni, neizprotami motīvi un iespēja skatītājam pašam minēt, kurš šoreiz būs vainīgais. Seriāls veiksmīgi izrādīts teju visās Eiropas valstīs, kā arī ASV, Kanādā, Dienvidāfrikā un Tuvajos Austrumos, kopumā tas tiek uzņemts jau vairāk nekā 25 gadus.

Šeit dokumentālo filmu cikla veidotāji atsaucas uz rakstnieka Duglasa Adamsa zinātniskās fantastikas komēdijas grāmatu "Galaktikas ceļvedis stopētājiem", kurā superdators ir izskaitļojis, ka skaitlis 42 ir galīgā atbilde uz visiem Visuma jautājumiem.

programme.title: Sporta studija
programme.desc: "Mūsu uzņemtais virziens izsakāms neformālā sauklī "sports sabiedrībai!". Šis virziens tika uzsākts jau iepriekš ar "Tautas sporta" sižetu sērijām un sporta laukumu kampaņām. Turpmāk LTV Tautas sporta sižeti būs tradicionāla "Sporta studijas" sastāvdaļa. "Sporta Studiju" vadīs rūdītie sporta žurnālisti Dāvids Ernštreits un Reinis Ošenieks, kā arī jaunās sporta žurnālistikas zvaigznes Andris Auziņš, Matīss Timofejevs un Raimonds Gekišs. "Sporta studijas" aktualitātēm sekojiet https://www.facebook.com/LTVSportaStudija

programme.title: 1:1. Aktuālā intervija
programme.desc: Raidījumā "1:1" [viens pret vienu] satiekas sabiedrībā zināma personība un žurnālists. Raidījums skaidro, analizē un ļauj izprast sabiedrībai nozīmīgas norises visdažādākajās dzīves jomās Latvijā un pasaulē, izprast personības nozīmīgumu, atbildību šo procesu virzībā. Viesi izvēlēti, ņemot vērā tā brīža aktualitātes vai arī konkrētās personas iespējamo ietekmi uz notikumiem nākotnē, – valsts pirmās amatpersonas, biznesa, kultūras un nevalstiskā sektora pārstāvji. Raidījumu vada žurnālists Gundars Rēders.

programme.title: Daudz laimes, jubilār!
programme.desc: Šoruden, Latvijas Radio simtgades zīmē, turpinām Jubilāra studijā aicināt Latvijas Radio cilvēkus, šoreiz – Latvijas Radio 3 Klasika direktori, muzikoloģi Gundu Vaivodi, kurai vasaras viducī apritēja skaista jubileja – 65! Ar Radio māju Gunda ir saistīta kopš 1983. gada un allaž lepojusies, ka darbā viņu pieņēmis Raimonds Pauls. Lai gan tālajā 1968. gadā Gunda, tolaik Gunda Tisenkopfa no Tukuma Raiņa pamatskolas 1. klases, uzvarēja TV konkursā "Ko tu proti" ar dziedāšanas priekšnesumu, kā arī dziedājusi dažādos koros un ansambļos, par dziedātāju viņa nekļuva. Pēc klavieru spēlēšanas Tukuma mūzikas skolā viņa izvēlas iestāties Jāzepa Mediņa mūzikas vidusskolas teorijas nodaļā un pēcāk – Jāzepa Vītola Latvijas Mūzikas akadēmijas Muzikoloģijas nodaļā, ko pabeidza 1984. gadā. Iegūtās zināšanas paplašina, gan strādājot LR Mūzikas redakcijā, gan veidojot klasiskās mūzikas raidījumus Latvijas Televīzijā – "Mūzikas laiks", "Operas ziņas" un – kopā ar pieredzējušo kolēģi Guntaru Pupu – "Eiropas muzikālās pilsētas". 90. gados sekot līdzi mūzikas procesiem Latvijā bijis emocionāli un aizraujoši, jo tieši tad lielas pārmaiņas piedzīvo daudzi kolektīvi, ieskaitot Latvijas Nacionālo operu, kuru tolaik sāk vadīt Andrejs Žagars, uzstādot ambiciozu mērķi – padarīt pašmāju operu par Eiropas līmeņa teātri. 90. gados aizsākas arī Lielās Mūzikas balvas iedibināšana, un Gunda Vaivode tajā ir klāt gan kā žūrijas locekle (kopš 1996. gada), gan kā pasniegšanas cerdmonijas scenāriju autore un vadītāja. 1996. gada 1. janvārī skanējumu sāk Latvijas Radio 3 Klasika, un kopš 2001. gada Gunda ir šīs programmas, kas no 4 stundu skanējuma izaugusi līdz diennakts apjomam, direktore. Nenogurstoši veicinot gan latviešu, gan ārzemju klasiskās mūzikas sasniedzamību klausītājiem, "Klasikas" kolektīvs par paveikto 2007. gadā arī pats saņem Lielās Mūzikas balvu. Savukārt 2009. gadā Gunda apbalvota ar Triju zvaigžņu ordeni. Brīvajā laikā Gunda kopā ar dzīvesbiedru mūziķi Juri Vaivodu labprāt rosās savā Tukuma mājas dārzā, kur zied gan rozes un peonijas, gan siltumnīcā gozējas tomāti, bet lielākais prieks, protams, abiem ir būt klāt mūzikas notikumos kā pašmāju koncertzālēs, tā ārzemēs. Skatot LTV arhīva materiālus, ar jubilāri, kā allaž, sarunāsies Andrejs Volmārs.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: The mask of Tutankhamun is one of the most famous finds of ancient Egypt, but close inspection reveals a consistent set of strange marks around all the hieroglyphs spelling Tutankhamun's name. Could the name have been engraved over top of another? In North America during World War II, strange and insidious-looking devices made of wood, rope, sandbags and gunpowder were found scattered across the northwestern USA and Canada. Who made them, and what was their sinister purpose? And in East London, a decorative clay bottle from the Middle Ages is uncovered. Not so strange, until the plug was removed and the bottle's contents revealed to include rusty nails, centuries-old human hair, fingernails … and urine. What is this sorcery?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: Easter Island's tall stone moai have long captured the global imagination, and there are still mysteries surrounding them. Out of nearly 1,000, why is one particular moai, called Tukuturi, the only one kneeling and sporting a beard? In 1950s USA, sightings of UFOs were a national phenomenon. Alien or not, many Americans didn't realize that the US military was working their own flying saucer: the Avrocar. And just after Newton's discoveries about gravity, 18th-century German physician Franz Anton Mesmer also proposed an invisible force that he called ""animal magnetism." To harness it, he built a device from a giant wooden tub saying it could cure any illness. Patients seemed to corroborate the claim, but could it be true?

programme.title: Paranatural
programme.desc: Theyre falling out of the skies, clogging up rivers and spoiling shorelines around the planet. Why are we seeing mass animal die-offs around the world? Scientists are searching for answers, while also studying why some species are beginning to vanish. In the United States, shrinking populations of bees and bats worry researchers. Are these die-offs natural occurrences, signs of a planet in distress, or are they beyond explanation?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Flying over the Himalayan foothills on a short hop from the Nepali capital Kathmandu to the tourist city of Pokhara, Yeti Airlines Flight 691 is cleared to land. And while a passenger live streams the final approach—and just seconds from the runway—the plane stalls and crashes into a gorge. Destroyed on impact, investigators find a scene of utter annihilation at the crash site. Eyewitness video gives them their first lead—the aircraft came in at a severe left bank. And the wreckage indicates the engines were in the feathered position, and therefore unable to provide thrust. A deep dive soon proves their was nothing wrong with the plane. And when investigators listen to the CVR, they're stunned to uncover overloaded pilots and a fatal case of mistaken identity.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Air traffic controllers hear an explosion when Air Algérie Flight 6289 lifts off from a remote desert airport. And moments later, the Boeing 737-200 crashes in the Sahara. An intense fire ravages the fuselage, instantly killing all but one of the 103 people on board. For an international team of investigators, it's clear the left engine exploded after liftoff—and that a fatigue crack eventually explains why. What's less obvious is why the highly-experienced crew of the state-owned national carrier was unable to keep their aircraft in the sky. Single-engine failures are infinitely survivable, and the pilots should have been able to recover by working together. Investigators ultimately find their answer in the CVR and in a toxic tug-of-war between a belligerent captain working at cross purposes with Algeria's first-ever female airline pilot.

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: The crew faces-off with a back-breaking, 200-pound giant in the deep waters of the Pacific Ocean, as they seek to help save the white sturgeon's favourite food; the mighty Pacific salmon. Their mission takes them far out to sea, and deeper into the rugged mountains than they've ever been before. To find these elusive warrior fish, they must brave massive waves, raft down treacherous, frigid rapids, and evade hunting grizzly bears.

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: Time is running out, and the team must return to the Fraser River to find and tag the 300-pound giant white sturgeon they are looking for. But first, they have to find their way out of the remote wilderness to deliver their salmon samples. Stranded by severe weather, they'll need to survive brutal rapids, rappel down terrifying cliffs, climb a massive glacier, and hike across rugged mountains if they want to succeed. And with a massive prehistoric fish finally on the line, the guys are in for a white-knuckled end to their northern mission.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Building Impossible with Daniel Ashville
programme.desc: Building Impossible, with Ashville brings ground-breaking feats of construction on the edge of possibility. From the construction of the world's largest ocean-going cruise liner, 'Icon of the Seas' in Finland to the ground-breaking Brenner Tunnel beneath the Alps on the Italy-Austria border, each episode highlights the skills, technology, and engineering brilliance that make these awe-inspiring builds possible.

programme.title: Superstructures: Mega Carriers
programme.desc: Venture inside the world's most giant-sized transporters. Watch a mega-sized cargo ship take a massive shipment across the world, soar to new heights on a giant airplane, and explore outer space on a super-sized space station. With the help of world-class engineers, architects and construction teams; experience game changing innovation layer by layer and everything that's hidden inside.

programme.title: Megastructures
programme.desc: Exciting documentary series that shows viewers some extreme and extraordinary construction projects- the biggest, tallest, longest or deepest in the world, and the machines that are used to create such amazing structures. The series features interviews with designers and project managers, who present the problems of construction and the methodology or techniques used to overcome obstacles. Some ''megastructures'' included in the series are US Navy's aircraft carrier, the USS Ronald Reagan, highway with no speed limit built in Germany, undersea tunnel built between France and United Kingdom, world's longest suspension bridge in Japan, twin tower skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, etc.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: It takes years of training to become an airline captain, but it's when a crisis strikes that a pilot really earns his stripes. An airliner is crippled after takeoff from New York's LaGuardia Airport, and the courageous captain pulls off an amphibious landing in the Hudson River. A catastrophic failure strikes high above the Canadian Prairies turning a Boeing 767 into a very large and very heavy glider. And, when the engines of TACA Flight 110 flame out in a violent storm, its captain pulls off one of the most remarkable landings in the history of commercial aviation.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Sometimes the trust between pilots and their planes breaks down, and the cockpit inadvertently becomes a struggle that pits man against machine. Eager crowds gather at an air show to watch the new pride of French aviation, but witness a fiery disaster instead. During a routine test flight, one of the world's most advanced planes nosedives into the Mediterranean. And, when a packed Airbus disappears over the Atlantic, investigators face a two-year deep-sea search for answers.

programme.title: Europe from Above
programme.desc: Europe from Above takes to the air over Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Poland, Spain and the UK to showcase Europe's finest cultural and geographical landmarks as you've never seen them before. Stunning aerial hyper-lapse photography allows us to visualise the changes of a season in seconds, as tulip fields in the Netherlands magically burst into colour and waterfalls in the Dolomites turn to ice. We reveal how tradition, engineering and natural wonders have shaped this epic continent - a vibrant portrait of these regions and the people who keep their traditions alive.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The no-fear gene: In a country where the punishment for espionage is death, a young CIA officer — and the real-life inspiration for Carrie Matheson from "Homeland" — is kidnapped at gunpoint during a routine intel exchange. Isolated and under threat, she must rely on her training and instincts to survive a tense 24-hour standoff that could end in catastrophe.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The Hollywood ending: During one of the bloodiest periods of conflict in the Middle East, a CIA officer faces the ultimate test of trust. Recruiting a mole inside al-Qaida is only the beginning; the real challenge is keeping him alive. Intelligence alone won't win the battle. The true test lies in safeguarding the life of a man who holds the key to countless operations. As danger closes in from every direction, loyalty, strategy and courage collide in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Midyat, Turkey, archaeologists uncover the vast underground city of Matiate, stretching across tunnels and chambers carved thousands of years ago. Evidence of churches, synagogues and Roman coins suggests it was once a refuge for people fleeing religious persecution. In Royston, England, workmen stumble upon a mysterious chalk-carved chamber filled with intricate religious carvings. Beneath Orvieto, Italy, a wine cellar excavation reveals Cavità 254, a striking Etruscan subterranean complex. Once a quarry or water system, its deliberate infilling with pottery and bones hints at ritual or symbolic burial practices. Finally, in Abarkuh, Iran, archaeologists map a massive subterranean tunnel network. Likely part of an ancient qanat water system, exemplifying Persian ingenuity, it used engineering to survive drought, war and desert heat.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Poland, miners uncovered vast salt chambers known as the Crystal Caves, filled with massive halite crystals formed millions of years ago. Over centuries, this industrial mine evolved into a spiritual and cultural sanctuary. In England, a declassified Cold War relic known as the Burlington Bunker is revealed. Built in secret as a sprawling underground government headquarters, it could sustain people for months, but new evidence suggests it may also have served as a strategic decoy. In Egypt, archaeologists discovered a 3,400-year-old New Kingdom settlement buried beneath ruins, challenging assumptions about Egypt's western frontier. Finally, in China, the mysterious Longyou Caves baffle experts. Their precise engineering and unknown purpose make them one of the world's most enigmatic ancient constructions that still defy explanation.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: In 1588, Robert Devereux, the Earl of Essex stood beside Elizabeth I as she rallied her troops to face the Spanish Armada. Young and charismatic, he was Elizabeth's intimate confidante, her favourite. But Essex's charm was matched by his recklessness. From arguing with the queen to leading a disastrous military campaign in Ireland, his behaviour pushed the limits of royal patience. Eventually, disgruntled and politically weakened, Essex launched a rebellion that would see him executed. Was he really out to seize the crown? Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace the volatile relationship between queen and favourite. Examining centuries-old documents, they uncover evidence-tampering and the devious tactics of an arch-rival, revealing that Essex was undone not only by his own ambition and hotheadedness, but also by ruthless court politics.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: It takes years of training to become an airline captain, but it's when a crisis strikes that a pilot really earns his stripes. programme.title: Drain the Oceans
programme.desc: Extreme weather patterns have threatened ships and mariners for centuries. The perfect storm?. towering walls of water, powerful winds and churning seas can overwhelm any ship. What brought down the largest haul of Spanish treasure off the coast of Florida? And what's the truth behind the strange disappearance of the mightiest invasion force of ancient times? Drain the Oceans reveals the secrets of Stormy Seas.

programme.title: Drain the Oceans

What brought down the largest haul of Spanish treasure off the coast of Florida? And what's the truth behind the strange disappearance of the mightiest invasion force of ancient times? Drain the Oceans reveals the secrets of Stormy Seas.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Hidden beneath seas, sands and stone, ancient medicine comes back into view. Off the coast of Italy, a Roman shipwreck preserves a sealed medical chest containing tablets and tinctures that mirror remedies still recognized today, including treatments for eye disease. In the Levant, poppy-shaped jars point to the world's earliest known use of opium, raising questions about healing, pain relief and post-mortem ritual. Far earlier, deep within the caves of Borneo, a 31,000-year-old skeleton bearing a carefully healed leg amputation reveals advanced anatomical knowledge, long-term care, and surgical planning once thought impossible in the Stone Age. Together, these discoveries uncover a medical sophistication far deeper — and far older — than once imagined.

programme.title: Mysteries of Ancient Medicine
programme.desc: Hidden in coins, bones and ancient texts, the struggle to defeat disease spans continents and millennia. In England, hundreds of angel coins uncover a royal healing ritual once believed to cure the "king's evil" through the monarch's touch, revealing why kings risked contact with the sick. In India, a 4,000-year-old skull bearing unmistakable signs of leprosy offers rare insight into a disease that shaped human history and the lengths healers went to combat it. In Egypt, papyri filled with diagnoses and prescriptions combine with newly examined skeletal evidence to suggest one of the earliest known attempts to surgically treat cancer. Together, these discoveries reveal how belief, authority and experimentation shaped the earliest fights against humanity's most feared illnesses.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: John Dudley rose from family disgrace to become the power behind King Edward VI's rule. In a court divided into two powerful factions, religious reformers and conservative Catholic nobility, Dudley betrayed friendships and crushed rivals, making powerful enemies along the way. In 1553, when the young king died, rumours swirled that Dudley had conspired to snatch the crown for his daughter-in-law, Lady Jane Grey. She was abruptly dethroned by the future Mary I and, without supporters, Dudley was arrested and executed as a traitor. Professor Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace Dudley's rise and downfall. They uncover how he navigated the shifting alliances of the Tudor court and re-examine the evidence that sealed his fate. For so long, Dudley was a winner in the Tudor game of thrones; ultimately, was he also its victim?

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads

Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace the volatile relationship between queen and favourite. Examining centuries-old documents, they uncover evidence-tampering and the devious tactics of an arch-rival, revealing that Essex was undone not only by his own ambition and hotheadedness, but also by ruthless court politics.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The no-fear gene: In a country where the punishment for espionage is death, a young CIA officer — and the real-life inspiration for Carrie Matheson from "Homeland" — is kidnapped at gunpoint during a routine intel exchange. Isolated and under threat, she must rely on her training and instincts to survive a tense 24-hour standoff that could end in catastrophe.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The Hollywood ending: During one of the bloodiest periods of conflict in the Middle East, a CIA officer faces the ultimate test of trust. Recruiting a mole inside al-Qaida is only the beginning; the real challenge is keeping him alive. Intelligence alone won't win the battle. The true test lies in safeguarding the life of a man who holds the key to countless operations. As danger closes in from every direction, loyalty, strategy and courage collide in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: It takes years of training to become an airline captain, but it's when a crisis strikes that a pilot really earns his stripes. An airliner is crippled after takeoff from New York's LaGuardia Airport, and the courageous captain pulls off an amphibious landing in the Hudson River. A catastrophic failure strikes high above the Canadian Prairies turning a Boeing 767 into a very large and very heavy glider. And, when the engines of TACA Flight 110 flame out in a violent storm, its captain pulls off one of the most remarkable landings in the history of commercial aviation.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Sometimes the trust between pilots and their planes breaks down, and the cockpit inadvertently becomes a struggle that pits man against machine. Eager crowds gather at an air show to watch the new pride of French aviation, but witness a fiery disaster instead. During a routine test flight, one of the world's most advanced planes nosedives into the Mediterranean. And, when a packed Airbus disappears over the Atlantic, investigators face a two-year deep-sea search for answers.

programme.title: Explorer
programme.desc: Bill Nye is feeling down. The therapist listens sympathetically, and diagnoses the cause: Bill is suffering from grief: climate change grief. Thus begins the most unorthodox hour ever devoted to the subject of climate change. Bill Nye, scientist, mechanical engineer, comedian, actor, and Science Guy, will walk through the five stages of climate change grief and, along the way, teach us what's gone wrong with our planet and how we can start to turn things around.

programme.title: Explorer
programme.desc: For more than 2000 years she's been revered as the Blessed Virgin, the Queen of Peace, and the Mother of God...but faith is not found in ancient scripture, it's a living experience. To truly understand the Virgin Mary, we must understand the millions of believers who are devoted to her. What we are about to discover is a complex world of spiritual passion, obsession, and corruption. This is a film that will explore the conflict between mystical experience and organized religion, the dangers of believing in false prophets, and the primal human need to connect with a divine mother figure. The episode follows a mother of three with terminal cancer as she makes her first pilgrimage to the miraculous village of Medjugorje, Bosnia-Herzegovina; where six schoolchildren claimed to see the Virgin Mary in 1981. Some of these visionaries still see her to this day. A million pilgrims make the journey here every year, yet the Vatican has not given the site its official sanction. No Marian site in the world is more popular - or controversial. We also meet Terry Colafrancesco, who founded Caritas of Birminham after one of the Medjugorje visionaries visited him in Alabama. A self-contained religious community,Caritas is dedicated to spreading the messages of Our Lady of Medjugorje. Yet, Cartias reveals a more complicated and perhaps darker side to Marian devotion.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsey sets out on a journey to some of the worlds most remote locations, where he'll be looking for an adventure of the culinary kind. Basking in the culture of each setting he ends up, his cooking has never been more inspired than when on such an adventure. Whether he's cooking at altitude in Peru or educating himself on Alaskan cuisine, Gordon is experiencing the world like never before and beautifully curating a delicious morsel for each setting. It's a far cry from the professional kitchen he's used to and he's handling ingredients that are completely new, but the food doesn't get better than this.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay journeys to some of the most incredible and remote locations on Earth in search of culinary inspiration, epic adventures and cultural experiences he will never forget. In the final episode of the series, he heads to the Alaskan Panhandle to explore the region and the cuisine. He's taught how to cook seal with a native Tlingit elder, scales a rock face in a treacherous snowstorm, and hunts grouse. He then prepares a feast with the local chef Lionel Uddipa.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: A lone diamond from grandma's ring is lost at Pittsburgh's airport by a young bride. Lost-and-found workers at Tampa International desperately try to find the owner of a fanny pack as it contains much-needed medication and $3,000 in cash. Travelers to a comic convention in Salt Lake City leave behind peculiar objects, including unique fan art acquired at the site.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Airport workers reunite travelers with their missing items, including a sentimental 40th-anniversary gift and a wallet brimming with $1,500 in cash. A man breaks into a song of gratitude when his two laptops are returned to him. Agents in Denver discover a bag packed with rotting fish and put on their detective hats to hunt for the owner of a jewelry box full of treasures.

programme.title: Inside Airport: Lost & Found
programme.desc: Travelers are reunited with lost treasures, including an expensive pair of vintage Air Jordans, sweaty boxing gear, and a beloved stuffed animal. In Tampa, the K9 unit is called in to ensure an abandoned bag does not contain explosives, and in Norfolk, the airport's auction of lost items, including a van converted into a mobile barber shop, raises nearly $55,000.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Innocent lives are lost when civilian planes inadvertently become targets, but each incident teaches us vital lessons about how to better protect commercial airliners from the heat of war. Charred wreckage in the Sinai Desert is all that's left of a Russian passenger plane. A Korean 747 plunges into the sea and Soviet officials soon admit to shooting it down. And, when a commercial airliner is blown out of Ukrainian airspace, investigators face geo-political roadblocks at every turn.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Compared to the number of suicides in the general population, suicidal pilots are almost statistically non-existent. But when they do emerge from obscurity to unleash their horrific plans on innocent passengers, the destruction they inflict is epic. A 737 cruising above an Indonesian jungle suddenly plummets from the sky. An Airbus A-320 crashes into the French Alps. And, Malaysian Airlines Flight 370 vanishes over the South China Sea, and remains one of the greatest aviation mysteries of all time.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Brand new: Car S.O.S is back with a new series, as Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend restore more classic cars for deserving owners and approach their 100th restoration. In this first episode, Tim and Fuzz head to Wellingborough to pick up a 1988 Fiat Uno Turbo, one of the fastest hatchbacks of its time. The car belongs to car salesman Gerry, a dyed-in-the-wool boy racer. Sadly, Gerry's ill health has meant that the Uno has been tucked away and left to rot on his drive. His friends and family hope the boys' treatment can bring some joy back into Gerry's life.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Huddersfield to rescue a 1992 VW Corrado, a German coupe that in its time was one of the fastest small family cars on the road. The car belongs to 37-year-old Ashley, a dyed in the wool petrolhead who even went as far as changing his surname to match his car. Sadly, when Ashley fell ill, his car ended up rotting away under a cover. His wife Kristina hopes a fully restored Corrado is exactly what her hubbie needs to bring some good fortune back into his life.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Rochdale to rescue a Opel Manta GTE, a rare German Classic straight out of the 1980s. The car belongs to former amateur rally driver Alan, who loved his Manta so much he couldn't bear to part with it, even when it went off the road. Suffering with ill health over the years and recently loosing his wife lead to Alan becoming bit of a recluse. His family and friends hope the Car SOS treatment could be just the thing to bring Alan out of his shell.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: For centuries, Mary, Queen of Scots has been dismissed as impulsive and self-destructive. Now, through new evidence and rare access, Professor Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow uncover deeper layers to this most famous historical figure. Travelling through France, Scotland and England, they trace Mary's journey from educated princess to embattled and imprisoned queen. They examine extraordinary documents, including recently unearthed coded letters, and reveal a woman who was charismatic, strategic and strong-willed, but who faced daunting odds, powerful enemies, violence and betrayal. As they investigate pivotal moments that led to her execution, Suzannah and Dan reassess Mary. Was her tragic fate really down to her own actions and temperament? Or did her cousin, Elizabeth I, along with scheming spymasters, deliver the final blow?

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: In 1491, a finely dressed young man travels Europe claiming to be Richard, Duke of York, one of England's disappeared Princes in the Tower, and the country's true king. The man quickly attracts backing from European rulers who see him as a vehicle for unseating the current king, Henry VII. Henry would go down in history as the founder of the Tudor dynasty, the young man as Perkin Warbeck, a failed and executed pretender. Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace the cat-and-mouse contest between Henry and his rival. It's a tale of espionage, unsuccessful invasions and shifting alliances. They uncover evidence at the heart of one of history's most enduring mysteries: Was Perkin an imposter, just a young lad from Belgium caught up in European power politics, or was he really the rightful heir to the English throne?

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: Duty Manager Dan must deal with a check-in outage at the start of the busy school holidays. Airside Safety responds to a life-or-death medical emergency on an incoming flight. 68 racehorses valued at $300 million dollars arrive from Europe. Overnight, the airside lighting team carry out vital work while dodging planes.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: On his first day, Australian Border Force recruit Nelson makes a find. A daring pushback trial ten years in the making involving multiple aircraft is under threat. Baggage manager Brodie faces the challenge of handling 2,000 bags during a system upgrade. A father and son pilot duo tackle a new flight simulator.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: En route to the Shetland Islands, a high-tech turboprop is struck by lightning, temporarily blinding the crew and disabling their controls. The pilots declare a Mayday as the plane plunges into a terrifying nosedive. Just seconds before impact, they manage to regain control. And once they're safely on the ground, investigators uncover an unusual feature in the plane that plays a key role in this calamity.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: Executed on charges of adultery and treason, Anne Boleyn is often remembered as the "harlot" who seduced Henry VIII into annulling his first marriage and forcing his country into religious turmoil. By examining what really led to her execution in 1536, Professor Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow reveal a far more complex reality. They discover Anne's appeal to the king was as much intellectual as physical. No mere social climber, she was a moral reformer who sought to use her royal influence for public good. But Anne's power evaporated as her relationship with chief minister Thomas Cromwell fractured and her pregnancies failed to deliver the male heir Henry demanded. Suzannah and Dan uncover evidence that the stunning charges against Anne were falsified; was she actually innocent? This is the story of England's most misunderstood queen.

programme.title: Northwoods Survival
programme.desc: Margot and her canine friends continue their pioneering trapping adventure, pushing deeper into the rugged Yukon backcountry. Desperate for building materials for his island homestead, Matty takes to the seas in search of timber. Billy turns his attention to fixing one of the most essential of all backwoods buildings: the outhouse. Emilie and Gilbert take their daughter Annie on her first hunting trip.

programme.title: Northwoods Survival
programme.desc: As temperatures plunge, Margot looks to her dogs to help her seriously raise her wood-harvesting game. Emilie and Gilbert travel to a remote, frozen lake, hoping to net a haul of food for their family. Yearning to bring a little more light into his backwoods life, Billy begins work on an off-grid power system, and Matty heads indoors to complete the latest and perhaps greatest of all his "Hillbilly" building projects.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: El Dorado International Airport officials must put their sagacity and experience to the test in order to detect the boldest and most original attempts at breaking the law that take place at the airport. In this episode, three passengers are caught carrying a total of 120 cocaine capsules inside their bodies and they in turn confess the dramatic circumstances they claim pushed them into committing a crime. Immigration agents face the challenge of deporting eight Bangladeshi nationals who are traveling using false documentation. Also, a young man shows great imagination when he hides a stash of cocaine in an unexpected part of his luggage. And a Dutch passenger dares to carry large quantities of cocaine in the fake bottom of both his suitcases. Meanwhile, customs officials work tirelessly to stop undeclared cash from entering the country, as it is sometimes linked to criminal activity.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: The Narcotics Division of El Dorado International Airport fights another day to stop drug traffickers, who find the most unexpected ways to smuggle narcotics out of the country. In this episode the officers suspect a young woman, but, upon closer inspection of her bag, they don't seem to find anything in the usual hiding spots and they'll have to dig deeper to determine whether she's trying to break the law. Then a young woman claims to have been tricked when she agreed to carry somebody else's bag as the officers find illegal drugs in it and two young men risk their lives by trying to smuggle cocaine capsules inside their stomach. Meanwhile, immigration officers stumble upon an unusual case as a Colombian woman arrives with her newborn baby from Germany but without carrying the proper documentation. The officers will have to determine if they can allow the minor to enter the country and if so, how.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: MIA CBP searches and questions a passenger coming from Jamaica because of his suspicious story and new suitcase. After finding anomalies in the bag, they begin to suspect he might be smuggling narcotics. JFK CBP Officers find a suspicious package containing cowboy boots and suspect something is hidden inside. At JFK, HSI opens pistons filled with cocaine, which leads to a controlled delivery and raid of the home to which the package was addressed.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: Explorer
programme.desc: Explorer ventures into Congo's Virunga National Park to take an intimate, compelling look at how Emmanuelle de Merode, a Belgian prince and the fearless new warden there, is fighting poachers to save his park. EXPLORER's Justin Hall talks to de Merode about his enemies -- some of which have attempted to assassinate him -- and a new threat, the prospecting oil companies.But to better understand the fight, Hall also embeds with the poachers themselves, the notorious Mai Mai, who consider poaching critical to their survival.

programme.title: Explorer
programme.desc: The human eye is considered an impressive organ. So much so, that some say the human eye is simply too complicated to have evolved. They say the eye is so perfect that it must have been "designed." But is it really all that? Because for every amazing thing that our eyes can do, there's an eye out there that does it better. From the eagle that spots a rabbit from two miles up, to the shark that sees through murky waters at night, from chameleon eyes with twice the view, and fly eyes with 10-times the speed, the world is full of animals that see further, faster, and clearer than we do. We will travel to the farthest branches of the tree of life, to understand how earth's creatures see their environments. And we'll use simulations and demonstrations to illustrate what life would be like if we had these capabilities. By the end of the hour, we will understand why animals have evolved the vision they have, and why ours is often so pitiful by comparison.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Chef Ramsay gets up close with rhinos, giraffes, zebras and hippos in the dramatic wilderness of KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, as he learns the secrets of the traditional cuisine of Zulu warriors and masters using a local "braai". He leaps from a helicopter into the raging Indian Ocean, harvests mussels on treacherous rocks and immerses into the local township culture, before cooking with beloved local chef Zola Nene for a revered Zulu chief.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Chef Ramsay channels his inner Viking to embrace the freezing temperatures of Norway in December, to unlock the elusive flavors of its cuisine. He dives for shellfish in the frigid waters of the fjords, wrangles a stomping herd of reindeer with the Sami people, ferments fish and eats sheep's head, before putting his new skills to the test to prepare a Christmas feast with local Chef Christopher Haatuft.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. Specializing in large farm animals, this senior is anything but retiring as he takes an old-school, non-nonsense approach to veterinary medicine. Unflappable and unstoppable, this doc routinely puts in 14-hour days and is a legend in his community. This new series travels with him across rural Michigan to care for every family pet and head of livestock in need of his expertise and kindness.

programme.title: Crocodiles of the Okavango
programme.desc: In Botswana's Okavango Delta, a young Nile crocodile embarks on her first season of motherhood. After winning the chance to breed, she faces fierce competition for nesting territory and the challenge of safeguarding her eggs through months of flooding, searing heat and relentless predators. Monitor lizards, mongooses, baboons and rival crocodiles all threaten her nest while she stands guard. When her hatchlings finally emerge, she carries them to safety in her jaws, but their journey has only begun. In a watery world where even crocodiles prey on their own kind, only a few of her offspring will survive. For this first-time mother, every choice is critical in a nursery where survival is anything but guaranteed.

programme.title: Croc Wars: Grumeti Vs Mara
programme.desc: Each year, nearly two million wildebeest and zebra cross the Serengeti on a quest for fresh grazing. But two legendary rivers stand in their way—the Grumeti and the Mara—each ruled by a formidable dynasty of Nile crocodiles. In "Croc Wars," follow these ancient predators as they prepare for the feast of the year, but not all crocodiles are created equal. In the deep, fast waters of the Mara, privilege reigns, kills come easy, and food is plentiful. In the rugged Grumeti, crocodiles must outwit, adapt and fight for every scrap. From brutal ambushes to stolen kills, this is a high-stakes battle for survival on two rivers with two strategies and only one chance to eat.

programme.title: Planet of the Reptiles
programme.desc: Reptiles are like scaly monsters from another time. As scientists unlock their secrets, the more remarkable they become.

programme.title: Crocodile - Australia's Greatest Survivor
programme.desc: In Australia, dominant saltwater crocodiles, called ""boss crocs," are the largest and most powerful animals on the continent. Even after unrelenting human pressure on their very survival, they are still the masters of their world. Over the last 200 years, the impact of human activities—such as commercial hunting, agriculture and population growth—pushed them to the brink of extinction. Today, these "boss crocs" have continued to not only survive but thrive.

programme.title: Day of the Dragon
programme.desc: The clock starts just before sunrise - when the temperature begins to rise. It's hard work being the world's biggest lizard on Rinca island. Competition is so fierce he can't afford to slow down. For the biggest male on the island, an ever- warming environment and shrinking hunting grounds threaten his survival across every hour of the day.

programme.title: Planet of the Reptiles

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Hungry crocs battle a dangerous pod of hippos. The hippos take on a group of male lions. A honey badger battles for life against leopards, and wild dogs cause chaos everywhere they go! In the wilds of Southern Africa, the long, dry winter brings a desperation to the animals who live here. Prepare yourself for a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: In picturesque rural Nebraska, husband and wife veterinary team Drs. Ben and Erin Schroeder live and work at the center of America's food chain, where the livelihoods of Midwestern farmers connect to families nationwide. Along with their two sons, Charlie and Chase, the Schroeder family is always on the go as their veterinary practice cares for the region's many animals in need. From winter blizzards to spring tornadoes and blistering summer heat waves, Drs. Ben and Erin overcome the obstacles with skill and heart.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: A new class starts at Panda School. Little cubs have spent their whole lives in the maternity unit but will venture outside for the first time into a world full of new sights, new sounds and new Panda Skills to learn. Mini Ling Lang, the oldest of the summer cubs, discovers her mum is an expert climber and tries to take after her. Su Jin Junior is headstrong, and his mom keeps him in line with a no-nonsense teaching style. The little twins are too young to start climbing, but they put their best paw forward when snow arrives. A snow day doesn't mean school is canceled; it means the lessons will be harder. While the littlest cubs are starting their schooling, Tian Tian's cub is up in the mountains and coming to the end of his lessons … inching closer to a life in the wild.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Against all odds, Kio survives a buffalo attack, but his troubles are far from over. At 12 weeks old, he is the youngest and most vulnerable member of the pride. To have any hope of one day becoming king, he must earn the respect of his older brothers and find his place among them. Just as he is finally able to gain their acceptance, the dry season sets in, and food becomes scarce. This leaves Summer to make an extraordinary decision to protect Kio's future.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: After a desperate search, Kio and Summer reunite with the brothers — but life on the fringes of the pride's territory is unforgiving. As Summer struggles to hunt for her inexperienced sons and prepare them for independence, the demands of survival begin to take their toll. When an easy meal proves too tempting to resist. The consequences change Kio's life forever, forcing him into independence far sooner than expected. Now, Kio and his brothers must learn to survive on their own.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio and his brothers have entered a dangerous new world. As the youngest, Kio is the most vulnerable. When he discovers a lush marshland rich with prey and a pride of lionesses, it seems they have found their new home. But this marshland already has kings. A brutal attack scatters the brotherhood and forces Kio to flee. Lost and alone, Kio's chances of survival are slim, but he finds the courage to call out and reunites with his brothers. Together, they face a series of trials, from buffalo hunts to clashes with rival males, forging an unbreakable bond. Finally, as a confident male lion, almost fully grown, Kio returns to the marshland to face the old kings. Victory will secure a kingdom, a pride and a new family. Defeat means exile. Will Kio fall, or rise and finally claim his place as king?

programme.title: Untamed Philippines

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: Moving from turtles of the Palawan coast to the unique National Marine Park at Tubbataha, to meet giants, whale sharks and manta rays. We also see how people can mediate between people and wildlife as we join a snake hunting team catching and translocating a deadly Samar cobra.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: The junior cubs at Panda School are learning essential life skills, and first on the curriculum is chewing bamboo. It's tougher than it looks. Even holding it right is a challenge for most of the cubs. Shy Qing Yang catches on quickest, leaving her twin brother, Can Yang, at the bottom of this class. But he's got other strengths and is soon outsmarting the others with his climbing abilities. Affectionately nicknamed "Dirtbag" is the quietest panda in school, but she's an A student when it comes to balance. She's introverted but self-sufficient, a characteristic that could shape her future. In a special semi-wild enclosure further up the mountain, Tian Tian is raising her cub with the ultimate goal of releasing him into the wild. And there is excitement in the maternity unit as they prepare for the arrival of the next generation.

programme.title: Panda School
programme.desc: Lessons at Panda School are getting tougher. The junior cubs are grappling with hard-to-eat bamboo leaves and attempting to climb trees in the rain. Playtime teaches them to channel their innate clumsiness to build a more resilient bear. The cubs begin to crack the panda code, each showing their true colors and demonstrating what their futures might hold. Dirtbag's wild-at-heart instincts kick in, while Can Yang's extroverted and adaptable nature shines through. A new pair of ambassador pandas prepares for life overseas, while in the maternity unit, the nursery cubs are growing cuter by the day and learning to walk. And up the mountain, the first snows present a challenge for Tian Tian and the cub she's raising for the wild.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais izturas dīvaini. Ko viņš slēpj? Barbabērni darīs visu, lai to uzzinātu. Barbapapas izlemj taupīt elektrību, taču viņu ieceri izjauc Barbagudrais un Barbabella, kas izgudrojuši slepenu elektrību patērējošu projektu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbazū gatavs palīdzēt, bet Barbagudrais un Barbabella ļaunprātīgi izmanto viņa labestību un padara viņu traku. Barbazū nejauši atklāj spēju atdarināt Barbatēti. Viņš to izmanto, lai sadalītu darbus brāļiem un māsām. Vai viņi to uzzinās?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni domā, ka ēdiens spēj likt tiem mainīt krāsu un formu, tāpēc izlemj atrast katram piemēroto ēdienu. Barbabo nav iedvesmas, tāpēc vairs nespēj radīt. Visa ģimene palīdz, iesakot jaunas zīmējumu tēmas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Vecākus pārsteidz aizvien vairāku reklāmas izkārtņu parādīšanās gar viņu ceļu. Gaisma no reklāmām ir tik spoža, ka naktī vairs nevar saskatīt zvaigznes un visur ir tik daudz stabu! Pietiks! Ģimenei jārīkojas! // Barbalala vēlas kļūt par kovbojmeiteni un Barbazū ir apņēmies viņai palīdzēt. Lai to panāktu, viņai jāiemācās aprūpēt govis un bulli. Tas nav viegli, bet, ja viņa pacentīsies, viņa būs lieliska kovbojmeitene.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rivera grib uzņemt krītošas zvaigznes foto, tāpēc kucēni ceļ observatoriju. Kucēni apmaldās uz dabas takas un rod veidu, kā nokļūt mājās.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Pirmās Celtnieklīča bibliotēkas būvēšana ir bišu pilna. Tas pieprasa īpaši saldu celtniecības risinājumu. / Vectēvs Grants māca Čārdžeram visus savus labākos deju soļus lielām deju sacensībām. Vai noklīdušas disko bumbas dēļ viņi neiegūs pirmo vietu?

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Briežu komanda
programme.desc: Pūciņas kundze ienīst minizvēriņus, bet sers Tērauds rada megazvērus, ar kuriem jātiek galā Briežu komandai. Konkurence saasinās, kad sers Tērauds uzaicina Briežu komandu piedalīties Briežu kausā, bet kurš maina noteikumus?

programme.title: Bena un Hollijas mazā karaļvalsts
programme.desc: Mazā karaļvalsts varbūt nav varen milzīga, taču tā ir ļoti maģiska. Un, kā katrā kārtīgā karaļvalstī pieklājas, tai ir savs karalis un karaliene, kas dzīvo pilī kopā ar trim meitām: astoņgadīgo Holiju un mazajām dvīnēm Deiziju un Popiju. Savukārt elfi mīt Lielajā elfu kokā, kur it viss ir vienuviet: skola, bibliotēka, daudzdzīvokļu nams un pat rotaļlietu un burvju nūjiņu fabrika. Šis koks ir mājvieta arī elfiņam Benam, pasaku princeses Holijas neparastajam draugam. Abi kopā viņi nemitīgi iekuļas jautros piedzīvojumos, mācoties kopīgi sadarboties, dalīties un risināt sarežģītas situācijas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Kaja meklē pludmalē apraktos niekus. Tims atbrīvojas no vecajām lietām, bet drīz saprot, ka ne visam vieta miskastē. Tims, Tija un Tomijs cenšas pārliecināt mammu un tēti par labu mīlulim.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabls ar komandu pārvācas uz Celtnieklīci, kur viņi dzīvo, spēlējas un būvē visu, kas vien nepieciešams.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Arvien jauni piedzīvojumi ar Doru! Piebiedrojies drošajai pētniecei Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu brīnumainajos piedzīvojumos - no došanās palīgā dzīvniekiem kopā ar Djego līdz apburtas nāru pasaules glābšanai.

programme.title: Bleizs un automonstri
programme.desc: Bleizs un automonstri ir interaktīvs seriāls datorgrafikā par Bleizu, lieliskāko automonstru pasaulē, tā vadītāju astoņgadīgu zēnu vārdā Eidžejs un viņu piedzīvojumiem Asupilī. Asupilī nav lielākas zvaigznes par Bleizu. Viņš ir čempions sacīkšu trasē un varonis ārpus tās. Kad vien ir kāda ķibele, visi vēršas pie viņa, jo zina, ka Bleizs spēj to, ko nespēj citas mašīnas. Viņš ir ātrākais automonstrs pilsētā - viņam piemīt bliezienātrums! Liekot lietā savas zināšanas, Bleizs spēj tikt galā ar jebkādu izaicinājumu. Ja situācija kļūst sarežģīta, viņš spēj iztēloties sevi par jebkuru mašīnu, pārvērsties par to un pavisam viegli atrisināt ikvienu problēmu.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Sapratuši, ka pieaugušie mobilo māju kopienā īsti labi nepazīst viens otru, Deizija un Krokodila kungs nolemj sarīkot pikniku visai apkārtnei. Viņi uzaicina visus un uzstāj, ka par visu parūpēsies paši. Viņi vēlas, lai cilvēki koncentrētos uz iepazīšanos, nevis visa iekārtošanu. Bet, tuvojoties piknika laikam, viņi saprot, ka nevar visu izdarīt, un varbūt ļaut citiem palīdzēt ir labākais veids, kā iedraudzēties ar kaimiņiem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabo, Barbabella un Barbagudrais uzbūvē māju kokā. Barbamamma ir apņēmusies novērst piesārņojumu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbalala saņem paciņu ar rozā zvēriņiem, ko nosauc par Skvīkijiem. Barbabravo, Barbalala un Barbabo ir apnicis, ka brāļi un māsas par viņiem smejas.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Kaja sastrīdas un sāk meklēt jaunus labākos draugus. // Tims un Kaja sacenšas zvaigžņu medībās pa visu Rambltonu. // Kad Tija noguļ iespēju redzēt griezošo zvaigzni, Tims mēģina tādu uztaisīt pats.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un omīte ir dārgumu meklējumos. Ir Rūkoņas svētki, un Tims grib, lai viņa rūciens ir labākais. Tims, Tomijs un Tija savā mājā atrod pazudušu mamutu.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims cenšas būt divos pasākumos reizē. Tims meklē Kajai uzkodu bez purvzāles. Pēc vairākiem zaudējumiem Tija cenšas uzvarēt visās ballīšu spēlēs.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Ir Draudzības diena! Kad Ātrmeistara dāvana Makrupuča kungam noiet greizi, viņam jālūdz Rabla komandas palīdzība. Rabla komanda palīdz Lūkasam uzbūvēt lieliskāko Zinātnes izstādes vulkānu. Vai Vingsija stāsies izvirduma ceļā?

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Motorei vajag palīdzību ugunsdzēsēju depo, pilsētā ierodas jauns ugunsdzēsēju kapteinis, lai apmācītu visus ķepaiņus. Čārdžers grib palīdzēt Sjerrai Spīdošajai ar viņas jauno šovu, bet viņa savainotā ķepa izraisa konusveidīgus sarežģījumus.

programme.desc: Bobijs vēlas pavadīt laiku ar Džeidu, bet vispirms jāuztraucas par cukurvatei līdzīgajiem mākoņiem. Vai Džeida ar Briežu komandu palīdzēs kristāla komētai parādīt varavīksnes krāsas? Tikai tad, ja Džeida iemācīsies uzticēties draugiem.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Dora atgriežas ar jauniem, fantastiskiem piedzīvojumiem maģiskajā lietus mežā! Pievienojies visīpašākajam bērnam - pētniekam un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam, kad viņi satiek jaunus draugus! Nekas nav neiespējams! Aiziet!

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Santjago, Lorelaja un vectēvs šķērso bīstamus ūdeņus, lai sagādātu Tomasam īpašu dzimšanas dienas pārsteigumu. Veco, labo ģimenes sacensību laikā visi sadalās pāros, lai atrastu leģendāros Slepenās alas dārgumus.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais izturas dīvaini. Ko viņš slēpj? Barbabērni darīs visu, lai to uzzinātu. Barbapapas izlemj taupīt elektrību, taču viņu ieceri izjauc Barbagudrais un Barbabella, kas izgudrojuši slepenu elektrību patērējošu projektu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbazū gatavs palīdzēt, bet Barbagudrais un Barbabella ļaunprātīgi izmanto viņa labestību un padara viņu traku. Barbazū nejauši atklāj spēju atdarināt Barbatēti. Viņš to izmanto, lai sadalītu darbus brāļiem un māsām. Vai viņi to uzzinās?

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

Tas nav viegli, bet, ja viņa pacentīsies, viņa būs lieliska kovbojmeitene.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Rabla komanda

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Rabla komanda izmanto savas būvniecības prasmes, lai pārveidotu super auto mazgātavu un nomazgātu fermeres Zojas sušķīgos dzīvniekus.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: "Dullo vecāku" galvenais varonis ir desmit gadus vecs zēns Timijs, kurš dzīvo izdomātā pilsētā Dimsdeilā, un tur viņam neklājas viegli. Timija dzīve ir bēdīga, jo vecāki reti kad ir mājās, viņu pieskata Vikija, 16 gadus veca ļauna auklīte, viņš pastāvīgi tiek apsmiets, viņu moka arī skolotājs Krokera kungs. Bet viss mainās, kad viņam uzrodas divi laumiņu krustvecāki - Kosmo, viņa sieva Vanda un vēlāk - viņu dēls Pufs. Timijs apjauš, ka laumiņu krustvecāki noteiktās robežās spēj piepildīt visas viņa vēlēšanās. Tomēr Timijs vēl ir maziņš un reizēm ievēlas ko tādu, kas netīši noved pie nepatikšanām.
